string.name: instance_switch_title
string.value: Switch securely between Cloud Mail services

string.name: instance_switch_description
string.value: Mailbox passwords are sent only to the selected service. Yunjianji stores only verified Huawei account and mailbox bindings.

string.name: instance_manage_description
string.value: Rename services or remove ones that are no longer in use.

string.name: instance_delete_description
string.value: After deletion, users can no longer access this service through Yunjianji.

string.name: instance_main_delete_disabled
string.value: The primary Yunjianji service cannot be deleted.

string.name: instance_delete_confirm_message
string.value: This service and its bindings will be disabled in Yunjianji. This cannot be undone in the app.

string.name: login_multi_instance_description
string.value: One HUAWEI ID, multiple mail services

string.name: login_instance_password_notice
string.value: Enter the full email address and password for the selected service. Your password is used only for verification and is not stored by Yunjianji.

string.name: login_instance_web_registration
string.value: Register on the selected service's website first, including any verification or invitation requirements. Then return to Yunjianji and bind that email using its password.

string.name: login_huawei_identity_changed
string.value: Your HUAWEI ID changed. Please sign in again.

string.name: login_instance_bind_failed
string.value: Binding failed. Check the selected service and your credentials.

string.name: login_instance_register_failed
string.value: Registration failed. Check the details and try again.

string.name: login_email_invalid
string.value: Enter a valid full email address.

string.name: login_instances_empty
string.value: No mail services are available. Please try again later.

string.name: login_instance_unavailable
string.value: The selected service is unavailable. Choose another service.

string.name: login_instances_failed
string.value: Could not load mail services. Retry to continue; no default service will be bound automatically.

string.name: login_registration_failed
string.value: Could not load registration rules. Retry or bind an existing email.

string.name: login_instance_open_failed
string.value: Unable to open the selected service's website.

string.name: login_instance_picker_description
string.value: Choose a service, then sign in with HUAWEI ID. Each service uses its own email credentials; registration on the primary service is not required.

string.name: platform_reauth_description
string.value: Restore service management without signing out of your mailboxes.

string.name: platform_reauth_failed
string.value: HUAWEI ID verification failed. Please try again.

string.name: profile_password_scope
string.value: Change the password for this service only

string.name: profile_delete_scope
string.value: Delete only this service's mailbox and its binding. Other mailboxes are unaffected. Data removal follows this service's policy.

string.name: profile_delete_target_confirm
string.value: Delete mailbox %2$s on %1$s and remove its binding? This cannot be undone in the app. Other mailboxes are unaffected.

string.name: profile_deleted
string.value: The selected mailbox was deleted. Other mailboxes are unaffected.

string.name: profile_deleted_pending
string.value: Mailbox deleted. Binding cleanup is pending; retry in Account Center.

string.name: binding_cleanup_description
string.value: Tap to retry binding cleanup. Mailbox deletion will not be repeated.

string.name: binding_cleanup_retry_failed
string.value: Binding cleanup is pending. Check your connection or verify your HUAWEI ID again.
